blocks.title: Public cloud
blocks.text: Public cloud internet par di jati, kai idaron mein mushtarak aur kisi teesre fareeq provider ke zair-e-intezam hoti hai.
Har size ke karobar physical hardware sambhale baghair virtual servers aur storage ke liye Amazon Web Services istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Public cloud ka hardware kaun sambhalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teesre fareeq ka cloud provider, gahak nahi.

items: Public cloud: mushtarak, provider ke zair-e-intezam, internet se (AWS).
